- Auth: OAuth 2.0 + mTLS options — need customer decision by 11/20
- Streaming + chunked responses: integration smoke tests + perf target
- Tool-calling: list of external endpoints we’ll call from the model runtime
- Eval plan: pass/fail prompts & metrics (attached redwood_eval_prompts.md)

Can you reply with names for technical owner and procurement? If you’re OK I’ll loop in our engineering lead (Karthik) and CS (Monica) to scope tasks.

> Team — looping you in to convert Leah’s replies into owners and concrete tasks in the MAP.

Thanks — confirming owners and adding details for the engineering spike.

Short technical plan (for spike 11/13):
- 30m meeting agenda: 1) SDK quickstart (JS + Py) 2) mTLS demo from Redwood dev env 3) Streaming example + partial transcript handling 4) next steps for API keys/procurement.
- Deliverables after spike (target 11/15):
  * SDK sample app repo with mTLS example (repo link to follow)
  * API access form filled by Acme (api_access_form.pdf attached)
  * List of streaming integration test cases + perf targets (latency under 150ms for partial frames)

Risks / blockers:
- On-prem fleet access: if Acme requires on-prem private deployment we’ll need network windows and firewall rule windows (time to stand up testing will increase).
- cert lifecycle: we can automate rotation, but we need cert issuance access (internal CA or vault).

Carlos — please confirm whether Acme will run tests against Redwood hosted endpoints or need a private deployment for telemetry. That will change the ETA for streaming tests by ~2–3 weeks.

I’ll open the SDK sample repo and share links by 11/15.

— Karthik
